_rule: Add an entry only in the same commit that makes the change. An entry whose sha256 no longer matches is a file that moved AGAIN afterwards, and is reported as a separate failure rather than silently re-blessed. THIS IS NOW ENFORCED: tests/test_baseline_unmodified.py compares the staged blob's sha256 against sha256_now. Until branch 3 it did not, and the list behaved as a permanent path whitelist.
_what: Files that DELIBERATELY differ from the rev44 publication archives. Branch 0 committed both trees unmodified so that every later change would be readable against a provable original; this is the register of those changes.
_why_a_list_and_not_a_switch: Deleting the byte comparison once the trees legitimately changed would have thrown the guarantee away to avoid the paperwork. Naming each divergence keeps it: anything NOT in this list is still an unexplained change and still fails.
_on_changed_by: changed_by is the branch for a change not yet merged, and the squash-merge commit once it is. A branch author cannot know its own merge hash, and inventing one would be worse than naming the branch.
